title: What Is Taken at the Counter and What Is Left Standing on an Equipment Rental and Demo Agreement
content:
A household still staying with the collective has a folio that goes on running, and a household that has paid nothing yet is a household the shop has not yet begun to collect from. Both change what the counter reaches for on an Equipment Rental and Demo agreement.

## The rule

Where the household holds a Resort Lodging reservation for the season, only the shop fees and the assessments raised on the agreement are taken at the counter, and what is left of the hire rate stands on the agreement to be collected another day.

Where the household holds no Resort Lodging reservation for the season, and the rental account carries no money collected against the agreement, only the hire rate and the add-ons raised on it, less the money already collected, are taken at the counter, and the shop fees and the assessments are left to the security hold.

In any other case nothing under this heading changes what the counter reaches for.

## The two conditions in combination

| Resort Lodging reservation held for the season | Money collected against the agreement | Taken at the counter |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | any | the shop fees and the assessments raised on the agreement |
| no | none | the hire rate and the add-ons raised on it, less the money already collected |
| no | some | nothing under this heading changes it |

The lodging row governs whether or not money has already been collected. The second row is reached only where no lodging reservation stands for the season and the rental account shows no money collected at all.

## Worked figures on a hypothetical agreement

Take an agreement whose rental account carries a hire rate and add-ons of 186.00 USD, shop fees of 112.00 USD, assessments of 22.25 USD and no money collected.

- The household holds a lodging reservation for the season: the counter reaches 112.00 USD together with 22.25 USD, that is 134.25 USD, and 186.00 USD stands on the agreement to be collected another day.
- The household holds no lodging reservation for the season and nothing has been collected: the counter reaches 186.00 USD, and the 112.00 USD and 22.25 USD are left to the security hold.
- The household holds no lodging reservation and 50.00 USD has already been collected: nothing under this heading changes what the counter reaches for.

Whichever row is reached, the figure the counter arrives at is never below zero.

## Point of judgement

**What counts as money collected.** What counts is money collected against that agreement as its rental account records it; an account carrying no such entry at all is what the second row asks for.
